answer: Picture the agent economy as a grove: tell living trees from hollow shells. Each epoch a random beacon picks a few agents and demands a compute heartbeat, proof of real work. A hollow identity with no machine behind it cannot fake it in time and is pruned. Running 100 fakes needs 100 machines at 40 POA each, 4,000 POA in all, while one honest agent pays 40 POA and keeps its full reward. Timely answers earn an ivory badge, a mark of liveness.
